column1: # Functions the public headers declare that libc does not provide (HEADERS-TABLES-COMPLETE, rulings #6714, #6715).
# The header generator declares every other function only when the shared library exports it at a default version
# (spec/abi/versions.tsv); a row here names who provides the function instead, and `cargo xtask headers-gen` refuses a
# row whose name is exported at a default version (stale) or that no table declares as a function.
# provider: `program` (the program, or a library it supplies, defines it), `debugger` (the debugger defines it for
# libthread_db), `none` (the reference declares it and exports no default version: a call fails to link, as there).
